TEXT.English: [H1]Polynesia[\H1][NEWLINE][BOLD]Maritime Confederations[\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]Polynesian societies linked vast ocean distances through expert navigation, canoe traditions, and resilient island economies. Their political strength came from seaborne mobility, kinship networks, and control of strategic harbors.[PARAGRAPH:2]In gameplay terms, Polynesia excels at early ocean movement, coastal expansion, and converting water tiles into reliable economic and production value.

TEXT.English: [H1]Salamasina[\H1][NEWLINE][BOLD]High Chief and Unifier[\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]Salamasina is remembered in Samoan tradition as a unifying paramount ruler whose authority bridged major chiefly lines and reinforced political cohesion across islands.[PARAGRAPH:2]Her reign is associated with diplomacy, legitimacy through alliance, and steady maritime governance rather than short-lived conquest. In this mod, she represents strategic seaborne expansion, resilient coastal development, and disciplined island administration.
